links.comparator_used: Other general LLMs evaluated in the same clinical diagnostic procedures: GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o, Claude-3-Haiku, Qwen2.5-72b, Qwen2.5-34b, and Qwen2.5-14b
links.effect: ClinDiag-GPT was trained on over 8,000 real-world cases; no numerical performance effect reported in the abstract, only that it “significantly outperformed” other LLMs.
links.quote: It significantly outperformed other LLMs in both diagnostic accuracy and procedural performance.

links.effect: No numerical effect reported in the abstract; collaboration between ClinDiag-GPT and physicians enhanced both outcomes.
links.quote: Collaboration between ClinDiag-GPT and physicians enhanced both diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, demonstrating ClinDiag-GPT's potential as a valuable clinical assistant.
